correctness.rationale: At a common time t the instantaneous tensor mixing eigenvalues on Walsh weight-j and Kq constant/standard sectors are cos^j(2t) and cos^j(2t)[q-2+2cos(qt)]/q. Cesaro extracts frequency zero, giving c_j and shifted frequency coefficient b_(j,q). All even-j sectors strictly survive, while odd-j Kq-standard modes survive only if q≡2 mod4 and j≥q/2. This proves all integers r,q, including first revival. Independently recomputed exact-rational sector ranks for 84 (r,q) pairs and integer spectral-projector Schur squares over a large prime in graphs of 6,16,48 vertices yielding ranks 3,8,29; general Fourier argument, not finite checks, proves formula.
